reason: I already pay for cosmetics in games and Finch, and four new pets plus a room to decorate is exactly my thing. $6.99 once is less than one month of most apps, so I would just grab it after a few days of using the free one.
objection: Will they switch me to a subscription later, like Goblin Tools did? I want 'one-time' to really mean one-time, and I do not want new pets to be locked behind a second purchase.
